label: Feature launch
description: A new or expanded capability that overlaps with ours.
example: Added a no-code audience builder for marketers.

label: Pricing / packaging change
description: What's included where, new tiers, bundles, or add-ons. We record what changed and never invent price figures.
example: Moved identity resolution from an add-on into the base edition.

label: Positioning / messaging shift
description: New category language, headlines, or comparison content aimed at our buyers.
example: Homepage shifted from 'CDP' to 'customer AI' language.

label: New integration or partnership
description: Connectors, co-sell deals, or marketplace listings that change who they can reach.
example: Announced a zero-copy connector with a cloud data warehouse.

label: AI capability
description: Agents, decisioning, or generative features, especially ones aimed at marketers.
example: Goal-based agent setup for lifecycle campaigns.

label: Review theme
description: A recurring theme in public reviews, summarized across many reviews. Never a single quote.
example: Long implementation timelines come up repeatedly for packaged CDPs.

label: Hiring signal
description: Job posts that hint at where a competitor is investing.

label: M&A or funding
description: Acquisitions, mergers, or funding that change a competitor's capacity or focus.

label: Customer win/loss mention
description: A competitor named in a closed deal, call, or renewal conversation.
example: Two closed-lost notes cite bundling with an existing contract.
